name: Biolytica
tagline: The Life Science Society, Maitreyi College, University of Delhi
about: Biolytica is the vibrant Life Science Society at Maitreyi College that empowers you to showcase your passion and talent across various fields, from academics and research to culture and creativity. More than just a club, it is a supportive community where every student can find their place.
support: Have doubts about coursework, lab trouble, or campus hassles? Approach any Biolytica member. We are here to help you get your issues resolved quickly and efficiently.

trinity.title: Signature Event: Trinity
trinity.text: Trinity is our annual departmental fest, a day full of fun, food, learning and unforgettable memories.
points: Cultural performances from music to dance
